decision_conditions: Insufficient information has been submitted to demonstrate compliance with Condition 3 of planning permission 26/00053/HOU. The condition requires the submission of a comprehensive schedule and specification of all external materials to be used in the development. Whilst details of the proposed brickwork have been provided, insufficient information has been submitted in respect of the remaining external materials, including but not limited to render, cladding, doors, windows, rainwater goods, roof coverings and other external finishes. In the absence of this information, the Local Planning Authority is unable to fully assess the overall appearance of the development or determine whether the proposed materials would preserve or enhance the character and appearance of the host dwelling and the Grange Park Conservation Area. Accordingly, the submitted details fail to satisfy the requirements of Condition 3 and are therefore considered unacceptable. The condition cannot be discharged, and the proposal remains contrary to Policies CP30 and CP31 of the Enfield Core Strategy (2010) and Policies DMD 37 and DMD 44 of the Development Management Document (2014).
